strings.SSL_NEU_CONTROL: {ssl_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.SSL_burgundy_wannabe_desc: SS-Obergruppenführer Eicke strove throughout his entire career within the Deutsche-SS to remain a loyal butcher for the Aryan cause. Now that Heydrich has betrayed Himmler and the Aryan race in favor of what Eicke sees as decadence and politics, he has taken it upon himself to build within his fiefdom a Burgundian Ordensstaat west of the Rhine.
strings.SSL_burgundian_pawn_desc: Loyal to Himmler until the end, the SS-Ordensstaat Lothringen remains a piece upon the chessboard that Burgundy can move about freely... for now.
